{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"content": """"One-time verification for LIFE-203: check the duplicate merge in data/registry.json.

Read-only: confirms each (head name, birth year) group has exactly one active
record, that the kept record has a valid household ID, and that no record was
deleted.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from core.ids import is_valid_household_id
from registry.register import load_households


def main() -> None:
    households = load_households()
    print(f"total records: {len(households)}")

    groups: dict[tuple[str, int], list] = {}
    for h in households:
        groups.setdefault((h.head.name, h.head.birth_year), []).append(h)

    problems = 0
    for key, group in groups.items():
        active = [h for h in group if h.status == "active"]
        if len(group) > 1:
            print(f"group {key}: {[(h.id, h.status, h.merged_into) for h in group]}")
        if len(active) != 1:
            print(f"  PROBLEM: {len(active)} active records")
            problems += 1
        elif not is_valid_household_id(active[0].id):
            print(f"  PROBLEM: kept record {active[0].id} has invalid ID")
            problems += 1

    merged = [h for h in households if h.status == "merged"]
    print(f"merged records: {[(h.id, h.merged_into) for h in merged]}")
    print("OK" if problems == 0 else f"{problems} PROBLEMS")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
